تتواكلوا (form VI)
# تَتَوَاكَلُوا (tatawākalū) /ta.ta.waː.ka.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَوَاكَلَ (tawākala)
# تُتَوَاكَلُوا (tutawākalū) /tu.ta.waː.ka.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَوَاكَلَ (tawākala)
